Adjectives Used in Applications of Data Communications
Adjectives are words that describe the noun of a sentence. There are certain words in the software world to describe application of data communications.

These are some adjectives used in applications of data communications with their meaning:

• Electronic: something related to the transmission of information by electronic systems.
• Optic: related to the use of fibers to transmit light or information.
• Actual: that exists in real time.
• Local: that takes part of a particular and delimited area.
• Global: that is worldwide or involves the whole world.
• Technical: that involves science or industry.
These applications are the global bridge between computers and communication.
The demand for data communications is growing every day, and services like DSL and optic cable modems contribute to the growth of these infrastructures.
Besides, in this new century, applications make lives easier and make communication faster and more efficient by taking advantage of the demand for more electronic methods of communications.
Two, accuracy; nowadays, data isn't being very accurate and sometimes it's altered in its technical transmission.
There is also the computer network; it shares different resources and is an interconnection of various computer systems that aren't in the same local place.
Simple Present vs Present Continuous in Negative and Questions
The simple present tense is used to express routines, habits, feeling and actions in general. On the other hand, present continuous expresses actions that are happening at the moment.

We use the simple present when we want to talk about habits or everyday activities.

The grammatical structure for negative sentences and questions is:

Negative statements:
Subject + Do/Does + Not+ verb + Complement

Questions:
Do/ Does + Subject + Verb + Complement?

*Remember that the auxiliary (Do or Does) depends on the subject you are using in the sentence or question.
*Don't forget that you can use verb to be without auxiliaries in negative sentences or questions.
Example: The applications of data communications aren't the core for networks.
Are the applications of data communications the core for networks?

We use the present continuous to talk about an action that is happening at the moment.

The grammatical structure is:

Negative statements:
Subject + Verb Be (is/are/am) + Not+ Verb + Complement

Questions:
Verb Be (is/are/am) + Subject + Verb + Complement?

Sasha: I don't know much about applications of data communications. What do you know about it?
Peter: The applications of data communications are the core for networks and the basis for the proper functioning of service providing servers.
Sasha: What kind of services do they provide?
Peter: Services like World Wide Web pages, electronic mail, online databases, careware, and multimedia content.
Sasha: Multimedia content like audio and video?
Peter: Exactly! These applications are the global bridge between computers and communication. It isn't possible to work without data communications even when casting variables. The demand for data communications is growing every day, and services like DSL and optic cable modems contribute to the growth of these infrastructures.

Sasha: Besides, in this new century, applications make lives easier and make communication faster and more efficient by taking advantage of the demand for more electronic methods of communications or by using strategies of evaluation like “call-by-reference” or “call-by-value” in computers programming.
Peter:You're right! In general, applications have three specific characteristics. One, delivery; data should be delivered to the correct destination. Two, accuracy; nowadays, data isn't being very accurate and sometimes it is altered in its technical transmission. Three, timeliness; it means as fast as possible. It is not useful to get data delivered late.

Sasha: Is there a device that helps with data communications?
Peter: Yes, the modem, which is an electronic device that encodes digital information. It produces a signal to reproduce the original digital data. There is also the computer network; it shares different resources and is an interconnection of various computer systems that aren't in the same local place.
Sasha: What about teleconferencing? It isn't very popular, right?
Peter: It is! This global application refers to meetings that involve people who aren't physically present at the same place. Other applications are Ethernet cables and wireless computing.
